**Why I stopped:**
- **Nothing was written this morning.** The last change was two days ago, on Nov 2. So whatever looks off since this morning probably didn't come from a change to this table. It could be an upstream job, a view or a dashboard.

Which would you like? I'd suggest option 2, then option 1 if the Nov 2 load turns out to be the cause.
